code:
# Risky: pickle.load executes arbitrary code in the file
model = pickle.load(open("model.pkl", "rb"))

# Safer: safetensors only reads declared tensor data
from safetensors.torch import load_file
weights = load_file("model.safetensors")
caption: A real, documented contrast: pickle executes code on load; safetensors was built specifically to avoid that risk.
